role: The efficiency enchantment: its metadata row plus the canApply special case for shears.
scope_reason: Enchantments reach the world through loot books and villager trades even with the enchanting table off (world.conf enchanting = off); the efficiency level's dig-speed bonus is live in the dig probe.

members.name: EnchantmentDigging
members.note: row 32: weight 10, digger, min 1+10*(l-1), max +50, level 5

members.name: canApply
members.note: the shears branch is not in enchant.c:can_enchant_item; canApply is only called by the switched-off enchanting table and anvil, and shears are neither traded nor looted enchanted

notes: The level's effect (the eff*eff+1 dig-speed bonus, ItemTool.getStrVsBlock via EnchantmentHelper.getEfficiencyModifier) is applied in csrc/engine/harvest.c from the held_enchant the dig case carries (csrc/engine/dig.c sets hp.held_enchant from the case's eff).
